name: Compliance Monitoring Workbench
one_liner: Rules-based and AI monitoring of HCP interactions, spend and field activity, with case management.
fits_when: HCP interactions and spend must be monitored against internal codes and caps
field activity comes from a CRM and spend from an expense system
rules and a risk model should flag activity for an analyst to triage
flagged activity is investigated as a case with recorded findings
business heads must agree and complete remediation before a case closes
auditors expect a complete trail from signal to remediation
gives_you: Nightly ingestion of HCP interactions and spend with employee and HCP masters
Monitoring rules with risk points and an AI risk score per signal
A signal triage queue that opens cases or dismisses with a reason
Case investigation with assignment, findings, business review and due-date tracking
Remediation actions per finding with owners, evidence and analyst verification
A case file 360 page with signals, findings and an activity timeline

catalogue.description: A compliance monitoring workbench for life sciences companies: HCP interactions arrive from the CRM and spend from the expense system, monitoring rules and an AI model score them into risk signals, and compliance analysts triage the signals into cases. Investigators work each case and record findings against policy clauses, business reviewers agree remediation for their teams, and analysts verify every action before the case closes.

compliance: Annual transfer-of-value caps per HCP and fair-market-value checks on honoraria
Investigators see only their assigned cases; reviewers only their team's
Maker-checker: remediation completed by the business is verified by compliance
Dismissed signals always carry a recorded reason
Audit trail of every signal, case transition and remediation step
